scenes.basis: 11:1 "came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives"
11:11 "Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem... he went out to Bethany with the twelve"
11:12-14 the fig tree on the road out of Bethany (11:12 "when they had come out from Bethany") - the roadside has no id
11:15 "They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple, and began to throw out those who sold"
11:20 "As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away" - on the road from Bethany (cf. 11:12)
11:27 "They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests... came to him"
